3gpp-ts-22.186-v16.2.0.title: Service requirements for enhanced V2X scenarios
3gpp-ts-22.186-v16.2.0.document_identifier: 3GPP TS 22.186 version 16.2.0 Release 16; ETSI TS 122 186 V16.2.0 (2020-11)
3gpp-ts-22.186-v16.2.0.verification_method: Downloaded primary ETSI PDF; extracted text and visually inspected printed pages 9 and 10 (PDF pages 10 and 11).

verified_claim.scenario: Automated-driving information sharing between a UE and RSU; lower and higher automation.

3gpp-ts-22.186-v16.2.0.declined_claim: No advanced-driving requirement class spanning 100–500 ms was verified. The 500 in advanced-driving requirement R.5.3-006 denotes metres of communication range, not milliseconds. A 500 ms latency requirement belongs to platooning reporting R.5.2-008 in Table 5.2-1, printed page 9.
3gpp-ts-22.186-v16.2.0.manuscript_handling: Cites the verified 100 ms requirement, distinguishes communications from task-completion deadlines, and retains a bracketed owner note about the unverified spanning class. Uses the title of the inspected version, not an unverified title from the prompt.

who-global-status-road-safety-2023.title: Global status report on road safety 2023
who-global-status-road-safety-2023.verification_method: Downloaded the primary WHO PDF through the link on its publication page; extracted executive summary p. viii and main p. 4 and visually inspected p. 4 (PDF page 16).
who-global-status-road-safety-2023.manuscript_handling: Estimation year is explicit. No other mortality statistic added; no simulator road-safety benefit inferred.

note: Both new references are reports/standards without newly introduced DOIs. Verification uses primary document text and page images; pre-existing DOI receipts remain intact.
